about: The speech-to-text stack of this tool, chosen per language. Change models here or pass your own file with --config. Every Hugging Face model is pinned to a commit (revision); GigaAM is pinned by the SHA-256 of its files.
checked: 2026-11-04 against the Hugging Face Open ASR Leaderboard (English, 2026-11-02), Artificial Analysis AA-WER, a 300-recording Russian benchmark (TypeWhisper), a Russian meeting benchmark (Habr, 2026-10-17) and the model cards
calibration: a 14:40 English studio call: 108 chunks split at speaker changes, 52 flagged with the differing words, the flags fell on the real errors; 4 speakers kept apart, including a voice-over; the context list echoed once on a music-only chunk (caught as echo); both models agreed on two wrong words, so agreement is not proof. Russian: on GigaAM's public samples --lang auto picked ru, GigaAM was exact where Qwen3-ASR made three errors, and on a 71 s sample the flags fell on the real error spots
review_every: 3 months: re-read the leaderboards, update the models and their revisions here

qwen3-asr.why: English primary: the most accurate open English model that fits a 16 GB GPU shared with After Effects (Open ASR average WER 6.14, second among open models); free-form context biasing. Russian cross-check: writes Latin terms in Latin and takes the context list

granite-speech.why: English cross-check: another architecture and training set (Open ASR 6.59, released 2026-10-20) with keyword biasing; where the two disagree, the chunk is flagged for listening

gigaam.why: Russian primary: 4.3 % WER against Qwen3-ASR's 8.9 % and Whisper large-v3's 5.2 % on 300 Russian recordings; 14.8 % against 30.1 % on ordinary meetings; punctuation and casing built in; 240M params
gigaam.weak: English names and terms inside Russian speech come out phonetically in Cyrillic («Фигма», «афтер эффектс»): the context list fixes them only through the cross-check

nemotron-diarization.why: who spoke when, up to 8 speakers, open weights (2026-09-23), 100M params; lower DER than pyannote Community-1 in a 132-recording comparison (English 10.3 % vs 15.2 %, Russian 4.4 %)

not_used.whisper / faster-whisper: whisper-large-v3 is 41st on the Open ASR Leaderboard (2026-11) and behind GigaAM on Russian
not_used.nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30: the best open model (2026-10-28; speakers and context lists built in) but needs 32 GB of VRAM or more, or a community 2-bit GGUF that is tight on 16 GB; revisit when either changes
not_used.GigaAM multilingual: moderate on English by its own README; the v3 Russian line is stronger on Russian
